title: 第17章 打一架第18章 奇怪了
slug: 夫人她只想修仙第370章自爆
content_zh:
“好暧昧。”
颜筝冷不丁地说。
林端不明白：“什么意思？”
“不，没事。”
颜筝讪讪，“那这件事就这么算了？”
“嗯。”
林端微微颔首，然后看向沈云熠，“此事因你而起，你因此受伤，实属罪有应得，颜筝毕竟无辜，向她道歉。”
颜筝有些意外。
按照颜桐说的，阵内五年，实际一年的说法。
林端和颜筝认识，少说也超过十年了。
这种情况下，林端能保持客观，颜筝都要烧高香了，听这话的意思，还有几分偏袒她。
她早就知道瘦青年和胖高个的计划，却隐瞒下来，放在现代社会，高低来个知情不报罪。
但林端毫不犹豫的将她护在身后。
更让颜筝意外的是，沈云熠这家伙居然二话不说，真道歉了！
“对不起。”
沈云熠一抬头就看见对方如同见到鬼一般惊骇，恼怒道：“你那是什么眼神！
我就不能道歉吗？不想要还我！”
“你都说出口了，还要我还什么？”
“你——”
“你们两个之间还没有完全结束。”

林端慢吞吞地说道。
颜筝话头一顿，奇怪地看向他。
可恶的大师兄，偏偏不往下说了！
故意吊人胃口！
颜筝偷偷翻了个白眼，面上还是一副乖乖女的样子，见没什么事了，和林端道别。
“回去吧。”
林端看了她一眼，淡淡道，“明日替我向颜桐讨要一株冰八角。”
颜筝哦了一声，只是奇怪，还有冰八角这种东西，修真界还真是啥玩意都有。
完全没反应过来哪里不对劲。
待她哼着小歌，开开心心地下了凌云峰才愕然一个转身。
靠！
她忘了她的根本任务！
她是奉颜桐之命来捉拿贼人的！
过去这么久，她还一点进展都没有，颜桐不会生气吧？可能性很大啊！
毕竟她怎么看都不像宽宏大度的样子。
林端不是偏袒颜筝，他心里自有一杆秤，你一下，我一下，总也不会让你难过。
当然，也平等的让所有人难受。
颜筝的无意识的捻动弟子令牌，其中另有乾坤，有一块独立空间可以供她使用，里面存放了一些必用品，包括传选符。
content_en:
"So ambiguous."
Yan Zheng said coldly.
Lin Duan didn't understand: "What do you mean?"
"No, it's okay."
Yan Zheng said sarcastically, "Then let's just forget about it?"
"Yeah."
Lin Duan nodded slightly, then looked at Shen Yunyi, "This matter happened because of you, and you deserved it for being hurt. Yan Zheng is innocent after all. I apologize to her."
Yan Zheng was a little surprised.
According to what Yan Tong said, five years in the formation is actually one year.
Lin Duan and Yan Zheng have known each other for more than ten years at least.
Under this situation, Lin Duan could remain objective, and Yan Zheng was going to burn incense. From what he meant, he was somewhat partial to her.
She had known about the plan of the thin young man and the fat tall man for a long time, but she concealed it. In modern society, it would be easy for someone to know and not report the crime.
But Lin Duan protected her behind him without hesitation.
What surprised Yan Zheng even more was that this guy Shen Yunyi actually apologized without saying a word!
"I'm sorry."
As soon as Shen Yunyi raised his head, he saw that the other party was as horrified as if he had seen a ghost, and said angrily: "What kind of look do you have!
Can't I apologize? Don’t want to pay me back! "
"You've already said it, what else do you want from me?"
"You——"
"It's not completely over between you two."
Lin Duan said slowly.
Yan Zheng paused and looked at him strangely.
Damn it, senior brother, you just didn’t say anything further!
Deliberately titillating!
Yan Zheng rolled her eyes secretly, but still looked like a good girl on her face. Seeing that nothing happened, she said goodbye to Lin Duan.
"Go back."
Lin Duan glanced at her and said calmly, "Tomorrow, ask Yan Tong for an ice anise for me."
Yan Zheng said oh, it's just strange that there is such a thing as ice anise, the world of cultivation really has everything.
I didn't realize what was wrong at all.
After she hummed a little song and got off the ground happily, Ling Yunfeng turned around in surprise.
Depend on!
She forgot her fundamental mission!
She was ordered by Yan Tong to catch the thief!
After so long, she still hasn't made any progress, wouldn't Yan Tong be angry? The possibility is great!
After all, she doesn't look magnanimous.
Lin Duan is not partial to Yan Zheng, he has a scale in his heart. If you give it a try and I give it a try, it will never make you sad.
Of course, it makes everyone feel uncomfortable equally.
Yan Zheng unconsciously twisted the disciple token. There was another universe in it. There was a separate space for her to use. Some necessary supplies were stored in it, including the selection talisman.
